name: AxCNH
oneLiner: AxCNH is AnchorX's centralized offshore-yuan stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 for CNH and backed by CNH cash reserves at regulated financial institutions.
collateral: Offshore Chinese yuan (CNH) cash reserves held 1:1 at regulated financial institutions; issuer materials describe AxCNH as fully reserved and redeemable for CNH
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 issuance and redemption through AnchorX for CNH transfers; the issuer publishes reported circulating AxCNH and corresponding CNH reserves on its transparency page

mintAuthority.summary: AxCNH is issued by AnchorX Ltd against offshore-CNH reserves. The Ethereum and Conflux FiatTokenV2 deployments each use a 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet as masterMinter and an independently identified owner and proxy-admin path; masterMinters can configure bounded operational minters, owners can replace the masterMinter, and proxy-admin multisigs can replace mint logic. A historical Ethereum operational minter has zero remaining allowance.

controls.label: AxCNH Ethereum masterMinter multisig
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25539995, masterMinter() returned this 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet, getOwners() returned four owners, required() returned 3, isMinter(masterMinter) was false, and minterAllowance(masterMinter) was zero. The verified FiatTokenV2 implementation gates configureMinter(minter, allowance) only to masterMinter; an exact-block eth_call from this multisig to configure a test minter returned true. It can therefore create or raise bounded minter capacity.

controls.label: AxCNH Ethereum token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25539995, owner() returned this EOA and eth_getCode returned no bytecode. The verified FiatTokenV2 implementation gates updateMasterMinter() only to owner; an exact-block eth_call from this EOA to set a test masterMinter succeeded. The EOA was technically a minter but had zero allowance, so its material authority is masterMinter replacement rather than immediate direct minting.

controls.label: AxCNH Ethereum operational minter (exhausted allowance)
controls.capDescription: The historical 1,000,000 AxCNH configured allowance was fully consumed; the active allowance was zero at the observed later snapshot.
controls.evidence: The AxCNH MinterConfigured event ledger records a 1,000,000 AxCNH allowance for this EOA. At Ethereum block 25539995, minterAllowance() was zero, so it had no remaining direct mint capacity; the masterMinter multisig can configure a new allowance.

sources.label: Ethereum Blockscout AxCNH MinterConfigured event ledger

controls.label: AxCNH Ethereum proxy-admin multisig
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25539995, admin() returned this 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet and implementation() returned 0xe9ac1d1e50db4082310815d2dad1c3ffdbc9c835. getOwners() returned four owners and required() returned 3. An eth_call from the multisig to upgradeTo(currentImplementation) succeeded, confirming its mint-logic replacement path.

controls.label: AxCNH Conflux masterMinter multisig
controls.evidence: At Conflux eSpace block 152153398, masterMinter() returned this 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet, getOwners() returned four owners, required() returned 3, and it was not itself an active minter. An exact-block eth_call from this multisig to configure a test minter returned true, confirming it can establish or raise minter capacity.

controls.label: AxCNH Conflux token owner multisig
controls.evidence: At Conflux eSpace block 152153398, owner() returned this 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet, getOwners() returned four owners, and required() returned 3. An exact-block eth_call from this multisig to updateMasterMinter(testAddress) succeeded, confirming it can replace the controller that configures minters.

controls.label: AxCNH Conflux proxy-admin multisig
controls.evidence: At Conflux eSpace block 152153398, admin() returned this 3-of-4 MultiSigWallet and implementation() returned 0x47a18acde0dacfea8fddb776d2b1dd3567ce2138. getOwners() returned four owners and required() returned 3. An eth_call from the multisig to upgradeTo(currentImplementation) succeeded, confirming the on-chain mint-logic replacement path.

review.evidence: AnchorX describes issuer-operated 1:1 AxCNH issuance and redemption against CNH reserves. At Ethereum block 25539995 and Conflux eSpace block 152153398, each FiatTokenV2 deployment had a 3-of-4 masterMinter that could configure minters, an owner that could replace the masterMinter, and a separate 3-of-4 proxy admin that could replace the implementation. Ethereum's MinterConfigured event ledger records operational-minter EOA 0x674241ca030bf7487d46d4fbf595c64a256e2c85 with a 1,000,000 AxCNH allowance, but it was fully consumed and had zero remaining allowance at the observed snapshot. The controlling multisigs are therefore the active mint and upgrade surfaces.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AxCNH is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.
